name: AppendCellsInExcelWorksheet
label: Append Range to Excel Worksheet
description: Appends a range of data (e.g., from a DataTable) to the active worksheet of an Excel.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet where data will be appended. If not provided, the active worksheet will be used.

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The DataTable containing the data to be appended to the worksheet.

fields.name: AppendMode
fields.label: Append Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to append data: To Named Cells or To Active Sheet.

selectOptions.label: To Named Cells
selectOptions.description: Appends data to a named range.

selectOptions.label: To Active Sheet
selectOptions.description: Appends data to the active worksheet.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the named range to which data should be appended.

fields.name: FirstRowHasHeaders
fields.label: First Row Has Headers
fields.description: If true, skips the first row of the DataTable as it contains headers.

fields.name: StartingColumn
fields.label: Starting Column
fields.description: The starting column letter where appending should begin (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'AA').
